Field Library

Personal offline reference — starter edition.

Four CDC text chapters. This is not a complete survival manual. First aid, shelter, repairs and regional maps are not included yet.

Source wording and captions are retained; photographs, video, scripts and site navigation are omitted. Links marked [online] require internet and are not included. Follow the table of contents to navigate offline.

Converted text has not been professionally reviewed or validated on the target e-reader. Compare instructions with their originals before relying on this conversion.

Contents

  • Water: How to Create an Emergency Water Supply
  • Water: How to Make Water Safe in an Emergency
  • Food: Keep Food Safe After a Disaster or Emergency
  • Hygiene: Guidelines for Personal Hygiene During an Emergency
